# py7zr and every package it pulls in, each pinned to one version and to the fingerprints (hashes) of its published
# files, for the CI steps that read the 7z files the archive tests write (ADR-089). Installed with
# `python3 -m pip install --require-hashes -r tools/py7zr-requirements.txt`, so pip refuses any file it was not told
# of here: a dependency's newer release, or a changed file under an old version number, never reaches CI on its own
# (backlog 0288). Dependabot moves these pins (`.github/dependabot.yml`). To make this file again by hand, on purpose:
#   echo "py7zr==<version>" | uv pip compile - --universal --generate-hashes --python-version 3.10 \
#     --exclude-newer <a date two weeks back> -o tools/py7zr-requirements.txt
# then put this comment back at the top.
